Question: In triangle \(ABC,\) \(AB = 13,\) \(BC = 14,\) and \(CA = 15.\) Distinct points \(D,\) \(E,\) and \(F\) lie on segments \(BC,\) \(CA,\) and \(DE,\) respectively, such that \(AD \perp BC,\) \(DE \perp AC,\) and \(AF \perp BF.\) The length of segment \(DF\) can be written as \(\dfrac{m}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(m + n?\)
